name: Omamessage
author: charleschao
description: Requires Tether by Zack Bartel installed separately (github.com/zackb/tether). Omarchy bar inbox for iPhone SMS/iMessage via the local tetherd socket — not a standalone messenger.

barWidget.description: Requires Tether (Zack Bartel, github.com/zackb/tether) installed separately. iPhone SMS/iMessage inbox in the Omarchy bar.

installation.note: This plugin requires additional setup before it can be enabled. Follow the upstream installation instructions.
